sample_unit: LLM outputs (20 Mandarin skin-cancer FAQs x 5 models)

links.outcome: Readability of LLM skin-cancer patient education across seven indices, by model and content category
links.effect: Readability varied substantially by model and content category; no single model was best across all readability metrics; quality and readability were largely decoupled.
links.quote: Readability varied substantially by both model and content category, and no single model performed best across all readability metrics.

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM performance on patient education questions regarding quality and readability, without testing a specific deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
